properties.description: Pins the relation on a member's pin in the core: a stated relation (part_of, uses, or both) and its interfaces survive the round trip and are read back by the upstream report; a member that says nothing is reported relation_not_stated, never defaulted; a uses link with no interface, or naming one this design does not hold, is no_interface_to_follow until the Interface exists; an unknown relation and interfaces without uses are refused and store nothing; an empty relation clears; a code dependency naming no design is never asked.
properties.name: a_hub_member_records_its_relation.rs
